550561.Description:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Prince Eric.)
[Under Vanessa's Spell] While you have a character named Ursula in play, this character gains Bodyguard and gets +2 Willpower. (An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)

550562.Flavor Text: Moving to the music, he begins to understand the true meaning of ohana and how he fits into the family he has found.

550563.Description: Remove up to 1 damage from each of your characters.

550564.Description: [Save a Soul] Whenever a character quests while here, you may pay 3 Ink to return a character card from your discard to your hand.

550565.Description: [Here Now, Don't Do That] When you play this character, move up to 1 damage counter from chosen character to chosen opposing character.
550565.Flavor Text: No matter what she tried, Belle couldn’t completely heal Beast’s wound.

550566.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[You Just Have to See It] [Exert] — Name a card, then reveal the top card of your deck. If it's the named card, put that card into your hand and gain 3 lore. Otherwise, put it on the top of your deck.

550568.Flavor Text:
"Have you ever seen anything so beautiful?” she asked, marveling at the Amethyst trees.
"No, cherie,” Lumiere replied, never taking his eyes off her. "I have not.”

550569.Flavor Text: He spotted a mysterious glow in the mountains nearby. Could it be the missing piece of the prophecy?

550570.Flavor Text: "After her, Flotsam! I can’t rule Lorcana without the Hexwell Crown!”

550571.Description: Chosen character gains Rush this turn. (They can challenge the turn they’re played.)

550572.Description: Each opponent chooses and exerts one of their characters. Those characters can’t ready at the start of their next turn.
550572.Flavor Text: "With both the crown and the trident, together we would be unstoppable!”

550573.Description: [Mystical Petals] [Exert], 2 Ink — Move 1 damage counter from chosen character to chosen opposing character.
550573.Flavor Text: The transformed rose made short work of the Beast’s wound. But even the gentlest magic comes at a cost.

550574.Description: [Scout Ahead] When you play this character, you may look at each opponent’s hand.
550574.Flavor Text:
"Keep an eye on the sea witch, my pet. Tell me everything.”
—Maleficent

550575.Description: [Here's the Trade-Off] [Exert], Banish one of your other characters — Play a character with the same name as the banished character for free.

550576.Description: [Fatten You Up] When you play this character, if an opponent has more cards in their inkwell than you, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

550577.Description: [Cunning Maneuver] When you play this character and whenever she’s challenged, each opponent chooses and discards a card.

550578.Flavor Text: "We totally took care of that thing you told us to do and definitely did not spend the day in Thebes ticketing chariots and stealing people's laundry."

550579.Description: [Reporting for Duty] While this character is exerted, if you have a character named Pain in play, your Villain characters can’t be challenged.
550579.Flavor Text: "We absolutely took care of that thing, boss. No problems, just great.”

550580.Description: [I Clobber You!] Whenever this character quests while he has 5 Strength or more, return chosen character with 2 Strength or less to their player's hand.

550581.Description:
Shift 6 (You may pay 6 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Prince Phillip.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[Swift and Sure] When you play this character, banish all opposing damaged characters.

550582.Description: [All Will Be Seen] When you play this character, look at the top card of each opponent's deck.

550583.Description: [Target Practice] Whenever this character challenges another character, he gets +Strength equal to the Strength of chosen character this turn.
550583.Flavor Text: "Ha! Now watch your old man work!”

550584.Description: Chosen character gains Ward and Evasive until the start of your next turn. (Opponents can't choose them except to challenge. Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)

550585.Description:
Choose one:
• Banish chosen item.
• Deal 2 damage to chosen damaged character.

550586.Description: Each opponent may choose and discard a card. For each opponent who doesn’t, you draw a card.
550586.Flavor Text: "How dare you double-cross me!” Ursula shouted, lunging at the other glimmer.

550587.Description: [Revitalizing Waters] Characters get +1 Strength and +1 Willpower while here.
550587.Flavor Text: "Flounder, this is perfect! I can’t wait to explore it.”—Ariel

550588.Description: That Hurts! This character enters play with 4 damage.
550588.Flavor Text: It wasn’t the severity of the wounds but the sickly substance that caused such unbearable pain.

550589.Flavor Text: "We must work together to heal the entangled.”

550590.Description:
[War Injury] This character can't challenge.
[Head of the Household] [Exert] – Ready chosen character named Mulan. She can't quest for the rest of this turn.
550590.Flavor Text: "I am ready to serve the Emperor.”

550591.Description: [Narrow Advantage] At the start of your turn, if you have a character in play with more Strength than each opposing character, gain 3 lore.
550591.Flavor Text: "You guys look busy—I'll just keep an eye on this lore for you.”

550592.Description:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)
Reckless (This character can't quest and must challenge each turn if able.)

550593.Flavor Text: His training was unsurpassed, but it was his courage that would see him through this fight.

550594.Description: Battle Wound This character enters play with 2 damage.

550595.Flavor Text: He sent the eels away when they came with the sea witch's offer. He didn't need her help making trouble.

550596.Description: [Fancy Footwork\] Whenever you play an action, this character takes no damage from challenges this turn.
550596.Flavor Text: Fortune favors the bold—no matter how small.

550597.Description: Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
550597.Flavor Text:
"He zigs, he zags—what else do ya need?"
—Phil

550598.Description: [Don't Cross Me] Whenever this character challenges another character, gain 1 lore for each other damaged character you have in play.

550599.Description: [We Have to Come Together] When you play this character, ready chosen character of yours at a location. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.
550599.Flavor Text: "There are too many of them for me. But not for us.”

550600.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[Bring on the Heat!] When you play this character, banish chosen opposing character with 1 Strength or less.
550600.Flavor Text: "Come on—what's the worst that can happen?”

550601.Description:
Shift 6 (You may pay 6 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Sisu.)
[I Got This!] When you play this character, banish all opposing characters with 2 Strength or less.

550602.Description: Reckless (This character can't quest and must challenge each turn if able.)
550602.Flavor Text: "I too wish to join this fellowship of Druun butt-kickery.”

550603.Description:
[Walk]! 2 Ink, Banish this item — Choose one:
• Banish chosen Hero character.
• Ready chosen Villain character. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.

550604.Description: [Strength of Mind] 1 Ink — Chosen character here gets +1 Strength this turn.

550605.Description:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Aurora.)
[Preserver] Opponents can't choose your items for abilities or effects.
[Royal Inventory] [Exert] one of your items — Look at the top card of your deck and put it on either the top or the bottom of your deck.

550606.Flavor Text: "This neat little scheme has Ursula's tentacles all over it. That sneaky sea witch . . . Wait! I can use this. She can keep those obnoxious Illumineers busy while I roll out my own plan.”

550607.Description: [Enduring Love] When this character is banished, you may put this card into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
550607.Flavor Text:
"Come my darling, homeward bound
When all is lost, then all is found."

550608.Flavor Text: "Strange things be at the edge of the map: sea witches, entangled glimmers, and whatnot. I’ll stay with me ship, thank you.”

550609.Description: Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character’s Strength this turn.)
550609.Flavor Text: "Isn't this Kristoff's hat? If he went this way, he'll be caught in that storm!"

550610.Description: [Consult the Spellbook] [Exert] — Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal an item card and put it into your hand. If that item costs 3 or less, you may play it for free instead and it enters play exerted. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

550611.Description:
Shift 6 (You may pay 6 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Triton.)
[Imposing Presence] Opposing characters get -1 Strength for each location you have in play.

550612.Description:
[Superior Swimmer] During your turn, this character gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)
[Keeper of Atlantica] Whenever one of your locations is banished, you may put that card into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

550613.Flavor Text:
"Some say he's easily distracted. They're not wrong . . .”
—Raya

550614.Description: Banish chosen item. Its player gains 2 lore.
550614.Flavor Text: "This could be just the thing I need to get my invention working.”

550615.Description: [Chilly Labor] [Exert] — Chosen character gets -1 Strength this turn.
550615.Flavor Text: Frozen ink can be harvested and processed to many useful ends.

550616.Description: [Help the Wounded] Whenever a character quests while here, remove up to 2 damage from them. If they’re a Hero character, remove up to 4 damage instead.

550617.Flavor Text: "How about we cut to the part where I make a quick escape and you yell after me? No? Can’t say I didn’t give you a chance.”

550618.Description:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
[Army of Brooms] This character gets +2 Strength for each other character named Magic Broom you have in play.

550619.Flavor Text: "Maybe what I really wanted was to prove I could do things right, so when I looked in the mirror, I’d see someone worthwhile.”

550620.Description:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
[Not So Small Anymore] While you have no cards in your hand, this character can challenge ready characters.

550621.Description:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character gets +2 Strength.)
Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 2.)
[You Gave It Your Best] During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, you may draw a card.

550622.Flavor Text: "I'm gonna hit you so hard, it'll make your ancestors dizzy.”

550623.Description: Deal 1 damage to each opposing character. You may banish chosen location.
550623.Flavor Text: A little snow never hurt anyone. That big rock, however . . .

550624.Description:
(A character with cost 4 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Banish all items.
550624.Flavor Text:
I don’t ask how hard the work is
Got a rough, indestructible surface

550625.Description: Each opponent chooses one of their characters and deals 2 damage to them.
550625.Flavor Text: "Ursula's foul creatures are not welcome in my kingdom!”

550626.Description:
[Resourceful] When you play this item, you may draw a card.
[Extract of Steel] 1 Ink, Banish this item — Chosen character of yours gains Bodyguard until the start of your next turn. (An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)

550674.Description: [Let Me Help You] Whenever this character quests, your other Hero characters get +1 Lore this turn.

550718.Description:
Sing Together 7 (Any number of your or your teammates' characters with total cost 7 or more may [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. You may reveal up to 2 character cards and put them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

550719.Description: [Treasure Trove] While you have 3 or more items in play, this location gets +2 Lore.

550721.Description:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
[Not So Small Anymore] While you have no cards in your hand, this character can challenge ready characters.

550838.Description: [Routine Ruckus] Whenever a character with 3 Strength or more challenges another character while here, gain 1 lore. If the challenging character has 6 Strength or more, gain 3 lore instead.

550839.Description:
Shift 6 (You may pay 6 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Sisu.)
[I Got This!] When you play this character, banish all opposing characters with 2 Strength or less.

550844.Description:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Ursula.)
[Now I am the Ruler!] Whenever this character quests, exert chosen character.
[You'll Listen to Me!] Other characters can't exert to sing songs.

551943.Description:
Sing Together 10 (Any number of your or your teammates' characters with total cost 10 or more may [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Chosen player draws 5 cards.

551944.Description: [Cunning Maneuver] When you play this character and whenever she’s challenged, each opponent chooses and discards a card.
